title: Helm, Kustomize & GitOps
summary: Package and parameterise manifests with Helm charts and Kustomize overlays, choose between them, and let Argo CD continuously reconcile your cluster from Git.
objectives: Explain what a Helm chart, release and revision are and how Helm stores release state
Install, upgrade, roll back and uninstall releases safely with --wait and rollback-on-failure

Choose between Helm, Kustomize, and both together
Explain GitOps principles and run Argo CD on kind with automated sync, pruning and self-heal
